title: Richard E. Byrd
summary: Richard E. Byrd was an American polar explorer and rear admiral. On his first Antarctic expedition, based at Little America on the Bay of Whales, he navigated the Ford Trimotor that made the first flight over the South Pole on 28–29 November 1929. He made four more Antarctic expeditions.

uncertainty.note: Life span from Britannica (born October 25, 1888; died March 11, 1957). The South Pole flight of 28-29 November 1929 is in the summary.

where.modern_name: Little America I base site, Bay of Whales, Ross Ice Shelf, Antarctica
where.historical_name: Little America, Byrd Antarctic Expedition base, Ross Ice Shelf (unclaimed Antarctica)

importance.justification: Led the first Antarctic expedition to use aircraft for the first flight over the South Pole, shifting Antarctic exploration to mechanised methods.
